author: The Current
description:
Jimmy Jam describes how Prince inspired his own work ethic and can-do attitude
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Jimmy Jam and Terry Lewis know a thing or two about work ethic, and some of it they learned from collaborating with Prince. During a recent conversation with MPR News' Angela Davis, Jam shared the ways the Purple One urged him raise his game. Friday, Aug. 28, marks the arrival of a new Prince compilation called 'Timeless,' which showcases newly unearthed vault recordings. On Saturday, Aug. 29, Jam and Lewis will lead Homecoming: A Celebration of the Minneapolis Sound at the Minnesota State Fair Grandstand.

Learn more about 'Timeless' and music at the State Fair at thecurrent.org.

author: The Current
description:
Watch Nur-D and his full band perform "Crush" live onstage
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube

On Friday, April 3, Nur-D lit up the stage at the Amsterdam Bar + Hall in St. Paul with a full-band set of his energetic and innovative brand of hip-hop, including the song "Unannounced," above. 

The set was part of The Current Presents Minnesota Music Month featuring: NUR-D, runo plum, and Agnes Uncaged with Special Appearances by jeremy messersmith, Singing Resistance Twin Cities, and the High School for Recording Arts Students.

More recently, Nur-D performed at the Pryes Stage at Schilling Amphitheater at the Minnesota State Fair on August 27, and "Crush" was included in Nur-D's energetic set — and it got the whole crowd dancing enthusiastically.

author: The Current
description:
See all the music-inspired crop art on display at the Minnesota State Fair
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

It's fascinating how all art forms seem to move and flow in ways that they influence and inspire each other. One place those influences are on display is in the Crop Art exhibit at the Minnesota State Fair, where people use the seeds of plants to create visual art. The Current visited the Crop Art exhibit to capture all the artwork that seemed inspired or influenced by music and by the people who make it. Various expressions included album-cover artwork, Prince-inspired work, musical instruments, portraits of musicians and more. 

The 2026 Minnesota State Fair runs August 27 to September 7. The Crop Art exhibit, a State Fair tradition since 1965, is located in the Agriculture Horticulture Building.
title: Music-related Crop Art at the Minnesota State Fair 2026
